name: load-e2e-export-named-identities-retained
body: Two tests/load_e2e.rs identities keep the graph_jsonl vocabulary although nothing in the file reads or writes an export: graph_jsonl_roundtrips_tier_nodes_and_spine and graph_jsonl_carries_only_repo_relative_identities now assert database rows, and the file's ignore reasons no longer list the retired artifact. They are retained under phase 8's accepted-debt list, so the names are deliberately stale rather than false. Upgrade when a future pass renames the retained identities to their database reality — a function rename that re-points this note's details edge together with the sibling name.
